test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following holds the record of presenting the maximum number of budgets in the history of independent India by presenting 10 budgets during his stint as union finance minister?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Morarji Desai__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Morarji Desai **served as the **4th Prime Minister of India.**
 
• He was also the** Home Minister, Finance Minister, and second Deputy Prime Minister of India.**
 
• He presented eight annual and two interim budgets. He is the Finance Minister who presented a maximum number of budgets.
 
• He also became the first Indian Prime Minister who did not belong to the Indian National Congress.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pranab Mukherjee - **He was the 13th president of India. Before this, he was the Union Finance Minister. He was awarded, Bharat Ratna. 
 
• **P Chidambaram -** He serves as a Member of Parliament. He also served as the Chairman of the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Home Affairs. He served as Union Minister of Finance four times.
 
• **Yashwant Sinha -** He was the Minister of Finance under Prime Minister Chandra Shekhar. He also served as Minister of External Affairs. He was the senior leader of the BJP.
